text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After three years of racing in the Twinkle Series, things have finally settled down. One early afternoon…

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text: It's precisely because she's so ordinary that seeing her win is so motivating!

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser's victory in the Arima Kinen has served as a moment of inspiration for countless people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser drops by my office while I'm watching the news.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wanna come to my hometown with me?
choice_data_list: Sure, but isn't this is a bit sudden?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well, my parents and I were just talking about having a picnic.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Since they're going to be making plenty of food, I thought you might wanna tag along!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… I'm sure this is where we're suppose to meet up…

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, there she is! Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A couple carrying a multitiered lunch box is heading our way, waving all the while.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: Sorry we're late, but it took a while to prepare everything. Nice to meet you. I hope Tannhauser hasn't been giving you too much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Ever since she told us she'd be bringing along someone special, I haven't been able to sit still.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: We pulled out all the stops with this meal, so I hope you enjoy it.
choice_data_list: It's nice to meet you both. And thank you. I can't wait to try it.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: …I have to say I'm surprised, though!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: How did you ever find such an upstanding partner, Tannhauser?! Way to go!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! What, no! This is my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Your trainer?! Oh… silly me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Misunderstandings resolved, we decide to search for a good picnic spot.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: I wanted to bring some boiled shark fin, but I just couldn't get the flavor up to snuff. Apologies, but the sides are all rather ordinary today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser's father lays out each tier of the lunchbox, and it looks like exactly what you'd expect from a famous restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wooow! Isn't this incredible, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hamburger steaks, fried shrimp, big rolls of sushi, simmered vegetables, rolled omelets…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: These are all super popular at our restaurant! Mom, Dad, thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everything is even more incredible than I imagined. I feel like I'm starting to understand where her unusually broad definition of "ordinary" comes from.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Still, Tannhauser's always had a tendency to trip up at critical moments.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: One time, she got selected for an interschool Umamusume relay and worked herself so hard she ended up with a fever on the day of the race.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: One Labor Day, she wanted to cook for us, but ended up spending all of her allowance making the practice dishes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Let's not go digging up the past!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: But… that's exactly why we were so happy when we watched the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: You pulled off the win, and everyone in the stadium was cheering so loudly!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, we were bawling our eyes out. You did great, Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, you two…

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: Thank you for supporting our daughter and helping her reach great heights.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Father
text_block_list.text: She might not be the flashiest girl around, but she's our little treasure…

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: We're just so happy we got to see her shine brilliantly like that. So many people said that they look up to her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: M-mommy… Daddy… Sob!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser's Mother
text_block_list.text: Eat as much as you like today! Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The three of them continue eating while tears stream down their faces. Watching them, I can feel the deep love that Matikanetannhauser's parents have for her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew! I'm stuffed! That was delicious.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, I never expected I'd be crying so much today.
choice_data_list: Really? I figured you for a regular crybaby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No way! I normally cry an ordinary amount! I just got really emotional talking about the good old days…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Anyhoo, that was great! Mom and Dad were sooo happy for me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Thank you so much, Trainer.
choice_data_list: You know, it's all thanks to your hard work.
You know, it's all thanks to your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, I couldn't have done any of this alone. Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thanks for sticking with me, even though I always flub it when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're the one who believed in me and taught me what's important.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You gave me the strength to keep moving forward. That's why… Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You've been my star these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Just teasing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that, but she also looks like she meant it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So, uh… I'm probably still going to mess up a whole lot. I'll probably catch a cold on the day of a big race or something.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But I can't imagine doing all of this with anyone else. So…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Will you stay by my side?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm so happy…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser bows her head slightly, looking just a tad more timid than usual.

text_block_list.name: Train Conductor
text_block_list.text: The doors are closing. The next stop is…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Agh! We missed our stop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my days alongside the ordinary, slightly clumsy, yet hardworking Matikanetannhauser are set to continue.
